title: Google Ads vs Meta Ads for a Local Service Business
description: Google Ads vs Meta Ads for a local business: which reaches buyers, which to start with by industry, and how to split a small budget between them.
dek: Google Ads usually works better for local service businesses because it reaches people already searching. Meta ads usually work better when you need to create interest or show something visual.

faq.q: Is Google Ads or Meta Ads better for a local service business?
faq.a: Google Ads usually works better for local service businesses because it reaches people who are already searching for what you offer. Meta ads (Facebook and Instagram) usually work better for businesses that need to create interest or show something visual, because they reach people before they start searching. If you can only afford one, pick the one that matches how your customers decide to buy.

faq.q: How should you split a small budget between Google and Meta?
faq.a: If you want to try both, don't split evenly from day one. Put most of your budget on the platform that suits your business best, prove it works, then test the other with a smaller amount. Two half-funded campaigns teach you less than one properly funded one.

faq.q: When should you use Google Ads and Meta ads together?
faq.a: They work well as a team. Meta ads build awareness, and Google Ads catches those people later when they search. Retargeting on Meta can also remind people who visited your site but didn't enquire.
